tagline.zh: CSS 官方感知均匀色彩空间 oklch():固定 L 只调 C/H,让对比度可预测、色板可推导。
tagline.en: CSS's official perceptually uniform space oklch(): fix L, vary only C/H — predictable contrast, derivable palettes.

origin.zh: oklch 是 Oklab(Björn Ottosson,2020)的柱坐标形式,收录进 CSS Color 4;『固定 L 调 C/H』的选色工作流由 Evil Martians《OKLCH in CSS》系统化(调研 06§1/§2)。
origin.en: oklch is the cylindrical form of Oklab (Björn Ottosson, 2020), standardized in CSS Color 4; the fix-L workflow was systematized by Evil Martians' 'OKLCH in CSS' (research 06 §1/§2).

effect.zh: 感知亮度 0–100%。默认 80(=0.8):Evil Martians 工作流中『L=0.8 的任何色相配黑字都清晰』;L≥87% 的背景配黑字对比度全部达标。
effect.en: Perceived lightness 0–100%. Default 80 (=0.8): in the Evil Martians workflow 'any hue at L=0.8 pairs clearly with black text'; backgrounds at L≥87% all pass contrast with black text.

effect.zh: 色度(chroma),0=灰。上限 0.37 取自 Evil Martians 实测的 sRGB 色域边界(P3 屏略高);理论值可到 0.5(MDN),但日常 UI 越过 0.37 即开始溢出 sRGB。
effect.en: Chroma; 0 = gray. The 0.37 cap is Evil Martians' measured sRGB gamut boundary (slightly higher on P3 screens); the theoretical max is ~0.5 (MDN), but everyday UI starts clipping sRGB past 0.37.

effect.zh: 色相角 0–360°。Evil Martians 经验映射:红≈20°、黄≈90°、绿≈140°、蓝≈220°、紫≈320°;默认 220=蓝。同一 L/C 下改 H,对比度几乎不变。
effect.en: Hue angle 0–360°. Evil Martians' rule of thumb: red ≈ 20°, yellow ≈ 90°, green ≈ 140°, blue ≈ 220°, purple ≈ 320°; default 220 = blue. At fixed L/C, changing H barely moves contrast.

note.zh: oklch() 自 2023 年 5 月起全主流浏览器支持(CSS Color 4,Baseline 广泛可用);相对颜色语法 oklch(from …) 属 CSS Color 5,支持较新。demo 的换算与显示是纯 JS 数学,不依赖浏览器 oklch 支持。
note.en: oklch() is supported across all mainstream browsers since May 2023 (CSS Color 4, Baseline widely available); the relative-color syntax oklch(from …) belongs to CSS Color 5 with newer support. The demo's conversion and display are pure JS math and don't rely on the browser's oklch support.

fallback.zh: 老浏览器收到不了 oklch() 时,先声明 rgb()/hex 再覆写 oklch()(@supports 包裹);demo 用 JS 换算出 sRGB 后直接以 rgb() 上色,天然兼容。
fallback.en: Browsers without oklch() should get rgb()/hex first with the oklch() override wrapped in @supports; the demo converts to sRGB in JS and paints with rgb(), so it is compatible by construction.

use.zh: 从品牌主色推导整套色阶:固定 L/微调 C,明暗档感知均匀
use.en: Deriving a full scale from one brand color: fix L, nudge C — perceptually even steps

use.zh: 头像/标签按内容色相染色而亮度恒定(示例:oklch(from var(--dominant) 0.8 0.17 h))
use.en: Tinting avatars/tags by content hue at constant lightness (e.g. oklch(from var(--dominant) 0.8 0.17 h))

use.zh: 宽色域渐变插值(in oklab/oklch),避免 sRGB 插值的脏灰带
use.en: Wide-gamut gradient interpolation (in oklab/oklch) avoiding sRGB's muddy gray bands

use.zh: 主题工程:组件只引用语义变量,亮暗主题换映射表;hover 用相对颜色 calc(l + 0.1)
use.en: Theming: components reference semantic tokens only; hover via relative color calc(l + 0.1)

avoid.zh: 把高色度原值直接上线——Chrome/Safari 目前直接裁剪 RGB 而非降色度,色相会肉眼可见地跑偏,建议手写 P3 覆盖规则
avoid.en: Shipping raw high-chroma values — Chrome/Safari still clip RGB instead of gamut-mapping, visibly shifting hue; hand-write P3 overrides instead

avoid.zh: 只用 OKLCH 就宣布可访问性达标——对比度仍需用 WCAG/APCA 校验(Evil Martians 原文警示)
avoid.en: Claiming accessibility from OKLCH alone — contrast still needs WCAG/APCA verification (Evil Martians' own warning)

avoid.zh: 把 oklch 的 H 当 hsl 的 H 使用——两套色相角度并不重合(oklch 的红≈20°,hsl 的红=0°)
avoid.en: Reusing hsl hue angles in oklch — the two scales don't coincide (oklch red ≈ 20°, hsl red = 0°)

a11y.zh: WCAG 2.1 对比度阈值(不得四舍五入):正文 AA≥4.5:1、AAA≥7:1;大字(≥18pt 或 ≥14pt 粗体)AA≥3:1、AAA≥4.5:1;UI 组件边界≥3:1(SC 1.4.11)。固定 L 的最大收益就是对比度可预测——但预测后仍要在最差组合上复核;Evil Martians 明示『仅靠 OKLCH 不保证可访问性,还需 APCA 校验』。
a11y.en: WCAG 2.1 contrast thresholds (no rounding up): body text AA≥4.5:1, AAA≥7:1; large text (≥18pt or ≥14pt bold) AA≥3:1, AAA≥4.5:1; UI component boundaries≥3:1 (SC 1.4.11). The core payoff of fixed L is predictable contrast — which still must be re-checked on the worst-case pairing; Evil Martians explicitly states 'OKLCH alone doesn't guarantee accessibility; verify with APCA.'

goal.zh: 实现 OKLCH 选色工作流:用 L/C/H 三个感知分量生成主色,固定 L 保证对比度可预测,并实时换算 sRGB 与对黑/白两色底的 WCAG 对比度。
goal.en: Implement the OKLCH picking workflow: derive a color from the perceptual L/C/H components, keep L fixed for predictable contrast, and live-convert to sRGB with WCAG contrast against black and white.

acceptance.zh: 颜色由 oklch(L% C H) 拼串生成,三个分量独立可调
acceptance.en: The color is built from oklch(L% C H) with three independently tunable components

acceptance.zh: oklch→sRGB 用标准数学(Ottosson 矩阵 + gamma),不引第三方包
acceptance.en: oklch→sRGB uses standard math (Ottosson matrices + gamma) with no third-party packages

acceptance.zh: 实时显示对黑/白两色底的对比度比值与 WCAG AA(4.5)/AAA(7) 通过状态
acceptance.en: Show live contrast ratios against black and white with WCAG AA (4.5) / AAA (7) pass states

acceptance.zh: 越出 sRGB 色域时如实标注(浏览器现状是直接裁剪 RGB)
acceptance.en: Flag sRGB gamut overflow honestly (browsers currently clip RGB outright)

acceptance.zh: 对比度判定不得四舍五入达标(WCAG 原文要求)
acceptance.en: Never round contrast ratios up to pass (explicit WCAG requirement)
